facts.value: The International Office for Business Sciences is the central point of contact for all questions regarding studying abroad. The team also supports international partner university students who come to study in Frankfurt.
For information on the recognition of examination results and the Learning Agreement, please contact the Examination Office. Your contact person is Ms. Silvia Benzel.
The consultation hours are canceled until September 9, 2026. Inquiries during that time should be sent via email to international@wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de.
You can also schedule appointments outside of open consultation hours. Please send us your proposed times.
Student assistants are also available. Please schedule an appointment via email at international@wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de.
For more information, please refer to our website.
